<subject>Component Supply 2024</subject>
<body>
My name is Andrea Reeves and I am the Service Unit Component Coordinator for Annette Reid this year. I understand you managed component supplies for your production lines last year. I have not yet received confirmation on who the supply coordinators are for your lines this year. Could you please reply to this email and confirm if you are the supply coordinator this year? If you are not, could you kindly provide the name of this year’s coordinator (please include the line numbers in your response). I have sent three emails to line managers today and would like to ensure the correct contact at your line receives this information as soon as possible. Thanks very much for your assistance!
</body>
<quoted>
</quoted>
